text:
Cassidy Rambo: Hey folks — first day! 👋 I’m Cassidy, joining Platform Engineering (inference routing team). Based in PHX, love plants, sourdough experiments, and very into bad pun dad jokes. also i have a corgi-mix named Mochi 🐶 :corgi:
Alex Kim: welcome cassidy!! excited to have you on routing, your experience with batching sounds perfect :tada:
Marta Lopez: hey Cass! quick q — what’s your snack energy? chips, fruit, or chocolate? (we must know) :rofl:
Cassidy Rambo: Chips + pickles combo is my vibe. also open to sharing sourdough if anyone wants to trade starter tips 🥖
Devon Patel: welcome!! if you’re ever in SF office next week ping me and I’ll show you the ramen place nearby 🍜
Cassidy Rambo: Thanks Devon — I’m planning to be there Thurs morning. would love the ramen rec!
Onboarding Bot: Welcome @Cassidy Rambo! To-dos: 1) Set up 2FA ✅ 2) Complete payroll form ✅ 3) Join #eng-runtime and #oncall-rotation — run `/join` in those channels. Your mentor is Alex Kim. More details: https://internal.redwood/people/onboarding
Jen O'Neill: hi and welcome! FYI we do a tiny desk-plant swap every month. bring something small if you want in :seedling:
Priya Sharma: quick poll — coffee or tea? react with :coffee: or :tea: (i'll tally!)
Sam (wasn't a participant but a nearby reply left out): :coffee: :thumbsup: (reacted)
Cassidy Rambo: coffee all the way. black. strong.
Alex Kim: also FYI desk booking is via `/deskbook` — e.g. `/deskbook @cassidy 2026-03-25 10:00` if you want the SF desk next Thursday
Cassidy Rambo: done — booked Thu 10am. thanks!
Marta Lopez: love the corgi name. Mochi pics plz? 😍
Cassidy Rambo: posted a pic in thread (uploaded) — Mochi is dramatic and steals socks.
Devon Patel: welcome again! if you want an intro to the routing infra ping me, happy to do a quick walkthrough.
Alex Kim: agenda: tiny sync tomorrow 11am to show infra and where to start. no pressure, just quick tour.
Jen O'Neill: :tada: welcome aboard, Cassidy — can't wait to grab coffee soon
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: 1-week check-in scheduled for 1864060800 (auto-created).
Cassidy Rambo: thanks everyone, really excited to be here! :smile:
